findings.description: New pins and archives explicitly bind owner identity; scoped import remaps outer owner only; old provenance remains unknown
Reject malformed Region ancestry and post-normalization pin/archive byte overflow without pruning
Refuse flat and nested Pinned Detach with ambiguous clipping, frame background/opacity or child shadows before mutation
Central style deletion now includes editor history, drafts and same-workspace clipboard; clipboard asset refs also protected
Portable import/export checks source-owned style and asset closure, duplicate private/public IDs, templates and archive-only dependencies before remapping
Malformed Tile dependencies block asset removal; strict cells/stash structure required by dependency collector
Page-only persistence rejects stored/queued common revision or archive mismatch and newly missing style references instead of silently using stale definitions
Nested pinned detach with remapped outer identity is refused rather than guessing live child identity in destination
Startup and full restore share workspace validation; inactive scope checked; reject nested registry and malformed Tile without overwriting stored payload; validate draft ownership before restore

Restore checks owner and revision after asynchronous guard, blocks concurrent editing, requires prior backup, reports CAS conflict and distinguishes post-commit UI failure; raw recovery preserves previous payload and exposes invalid backups as raw exports

Q-005 public images hidden, never removed by library reset; only unreferenced active private resources removed; mixed delete stops on failed public mutation; private delete/undo blocked during uncertain persistence
A13 expected-side history snapshots and editor/clipboard references protected; component delete checks draft identity and live edges without conflating closed snapshot IDs
Valid common archive records retain additive metadata during normalization; no fabricated legacy provenance

openFindings: Runtime acceptance required: startup/restore with invalid inactive workspace, legacy pins, raw recovery, CAS conflict, actual IndexedDB/ZIP/PDF and A13 history/flow.
Legacy archive provenance and nested detach after scoped import remain restricted. Legacy unresolved styles remain deliberately unresolved; portable export may be refused.

Source-only gate is conditional, not release approval. Review raw recovery size/availability, startup normalization compatibility, archive metadata limits and queue/history behavior before owner acceptance.
limits: No schema version or Native change; valid legacy archive metadata preserved
Startup validation may require recovery for previously latent invalid inactive records; no stored payload overwritten on validation failure
Raw recovery refuses overwrite if prior payload backup cannot be made; export size limit remains
Conditional source gate only; all acceptance scenarios NOT_RUN
